title: Feature launch: stylised app UI with 3D camera (Canvas + CSS 3D)
description: The SaaS / app launch look: an abstract app window built in code (title bar, sidebar, KPI cards, a chart widget, a toggle list, a notification toast) rises into a tilted 3D view; a perspective camera glides to three regions while numbered callouts (headline + one line) appear beside them on curved leaders, and a cursor hovers the chart, clicks a toggle and a toast with ripples. The window sinks away and the product name and a call-to-action button land; the cursor clicks it. The interface is a skeleton mock, never a real product screen. 16:9 sets callouts beside the element; 9:16 and 1:1 set them below.

product.description: Product name, shown in the sidebar and as the end title (copied exactly)

headlines.description: Feature headlines in order, 2-5 words each; they pair with the chart, the toggle and the notification

default: Live charts update the moment your data does
Flip a switch and the routine runs itself
Smart alerts surface what needs you now
details.description: One supporting line under each headline (same order; empty string for none)

cta.description: Call-to-action button label on the end card (empty for none)

disclaimer.description: Small line under the end card saying the UI is a mock (empty for none)

palette.description: Ground, UI surface, ink and accent; ink is replaced when it would fall under 4.5:1 contrast

tilt.description: How far the camera tilts the window in 3D (0 = flat)

glow.description: Strength of the soft background glows

cursor.description: Show the cursor that hovers and clicks

mark.description: Product mark: the name's first letter on an accent tile, or a plain dot tile

notes: Needs `pip install playwright` and `playwright install chromium-headless-shell`.
Uses the system's Inter (fonts-inter) when installed, else Helvetica Neue/Arial.
The interface is drawn from skeleton bars: it is a stylised mock and never shows a real product's screens, data or features.
Each feature needs at least 1.8 s; the page throws when the duration is too short for the feature count.
